annotations.title: How many are left: UK licensed and SORN counts for a car model

description: How many of a car model are still licensed on UK roads and how many are declared off the road (SORN), from DVLA vehicle licensing statistics published by the Department for Transport. Useful for "how many Ford Capris are left" style questions and for rare, classic and future-classic cars. Returns the latest quarter and a link to the MotifyMe page with the trend over time. Only models MotifyMe publishes a page for are covered.

model.description: Make and model, for example Ford Capri or Saab 9-3
